item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · BLDP
item.scanner:headline: Acquires GeoPura for £275M; close later in 2026
item.description:
Acquires GeoPura for £275M; close later in 2026

Entered into a definitive agreement to acquire GeoPura Limited for £275 million in upfront consideration. The acquisition is expected to close later in 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. The deal aims to establish Ballard as an energy-as-a-service provider, combining its fuel cell technology with GeoPura's hydrogen genset leasing model.

About: Ballard Power Systems Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, sale, and service of proton exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell products. The company offers products for various applications focusing on power products for bus, truck, rail, marine, stationary, and emerging market, such as material handling, off-road, and other applications.

  • Counterparty: GeoPura Limited
  • Deal value: £275 million
  • Consideration: cash
  • Announced: 2026-07-31
  • Expected Close: 2026
  • Next catalyst: regulatory approvals and closing conditions

item.title: 📤 Divestiture · HSBC
item.scanner:headline: Sells AUD36B Australian loan portfolio to Blackstone for ~US$25B cash
item.description:
Sells AUD36B Australian loan portfolio to Blackstone for ~US$25B cash

Announces the sale of its Australian home and personal loan portfolio (book value AUD36B, ~US$25B) to Virgo BidCo Pty Ltd, an entity wholly owned by funds managed by Blackstone. The consideration is cash at par value plus adjustments, settled at closing. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory and competition approvals. HSBC expects an immaterial loss of less than US$0.1B and will incur US$0.3B in restructuring costs. The remainder of HSBC Australia's retail business will be wound down over 18 months.

About: HSBC Holdings plc engages in the provision of banking and financial products and services worldwide. It operates through four segments: Hong Kong, UK, Corporate and Institutional Banking, and International Wealth and Premier Banking. The Hong Kong segment is involved in the retail banking and wealth and commercial banking of HSBC Hong Kong and Hang Seng Bank.

  • Counterparty: Blackstone (via Virgo BidCo Pty Ltd)
  • Deal value: AUD36 billion (~US$25 billion)
  • Consideration: cash
  • Announced: 2026-07-31
  • Expected Close: first half of 2027
  • Next catalyst: regulatory approvals (FIRB, ACCC, APRA, ASIC)

item.description:
Advisory committee votes 10-3 RP1 efficacy evaluable; FDA decision Aug 2

Replimune announced that the FDA's Cellular, Tissue, and Gene Therapies Advisory Committee voted 10 to 3 that the efficacy results from the IGNYTE study for RP1 in advanced melanoma are evaluable and clinically meaningful. The FDA's target action date under the Class 1 resubmission is August 2, 2026.

About: Replimune Group, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of oncolytic immunotherapies to treat cancer in the United States and the United Kingdom. The company’s proprietary oncolytic immunotherapy product candidates are designed and intended to activate the immune system against cancer. Its lead product candidate is RP1, a selectively replicating version of HSV-1 that expresses GALV-GP R(-) and human GM-CSF for a range of solid tumors.

Copra common stockholders received $76.04 cash + 0.4346 COCO shares per share; preferred stockholders received $108.61 cash per share. The merger closed on July 22, 2026.

item.description:
Acquires Paulson's 40% Donlin stake for ~35% of New NG stock; redomiciles to Delaware

NOVAGOLD entered definitive agreements to acquire Paulson's 40% interest in Donlin Gold, increasing ownership to 100%. Consideration is all-stock: current NG shareholders (including Paulson) will own ~65% of New NG, while Paulson receives ~35% (plus existing stake for ~40% economic interest). New NG will be a Delaware corporation; closing expected Q4 2026, subject to 66 2/3% shareholder vote, court, regulatory, and stock exchange approvals.
